# proxmox_guest_dbus_vmstate (Resource)

Starts or stops the QEMU DBus VMState helper through `POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/dbus-vmstate`. The API requires the VM PID to be visible on the addressed node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_dbus_vmstate" "helper" {
  node     = "pve"
  vmid     = 100
  action   = "start"
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
